dev_history_rule: DEV targets receive only prior chronological TRAIN and earlier DEV interactions, with unknown-to-TRAIN authors omitted from Base input; no TEST events allowed

checkpoint_selection.cohort: 4096 fixed order-statistic sampled from 50049 frozen DEV events only
checkpoint_selection.negative_rule: uniform without replacement among concurrently active distinct warm TRAIN authors at event timestamp, exclude target
checkpoint_selection.choose: maximize sampled-active DEV NDCG@10, earliest epoch wins ties

zero_warm_history.rule: fallback to TRAIN-only popularity ranking, report count and share, no learned cold embedding

followup: After checkpoint selection score frozen full-active DEV cohort; TEST remains locked until all gates frozen
